CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY sf_bikeshare_ops_pkg IS

  PROCEDURE print_landmark_station_ops(
    p_landmark IN SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS.landmark%TYPE
  ) IS
    co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

    CURSOR cur_station_ops IS
      WITH trip_starts AS (
        SELECT t.start_station_id AS station_id,
               COUNT(*) AS trip_starts
          FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_TRIPS t
         GROUP BY t.start_station_id
      ),
      latest_status AS (
        SELECT s.station_id,
               s.time AS status_time,
               s.bikes_available,
               s.docks_available
          FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS s
          INNER JOIN (
            SELECT station_id,
                   MAX(time) AS max_time
              FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS
             GROUP BY station_id
          ) mx
            ON mx.station_id = s.station_id
           AND mx.max_time = s.time
      ),
      ranked AS (
        SELECT st.station_id,
               st.name AS station_name,
               ts.trip_starts,
               ls.status_time,
               ls.bikes_available,
               ls.docks_available,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ts.trip_starts DESC, st.name ASC) AS rn
          FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS st
          INNER JOIN trip_starts ts
            ON ts.station_id = st.station_id
          LEFT OUTER JOIN latest_status ls
            ON ls.station_id = st.station_id
         WHERE st.landmark = p_landmark
      )
      SELECT station_id,
             station_name,
             trip_starts,
             status_time,
             bikes_available,
             docks_available
        FROM ranked
       WHERE rn <= co_report_limit
       ORDER BY rn;

    lv_counter PLS_INTEGER := 0;
  BEGIN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Bike Share Ops Report - Landmark: ' || NVL(p_landmark, 'NULL'));
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Top stations by trip starts (limited to ' || co_report_limit || '):');

    FOR rec IN cur_station_ops LOOP
      lv_counter := lv_counter + 1;

      -- Control-flow guard: handle unexpected/null metrics gracefully.
      IF rec.trip_starts IS NULL OR rec.trip_starts < 0 THEN
        CONTINUE;
      END IF;

      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
        lv_counter || ') Station: ' || rec.station_name || ' (ID=' || rec.station_id || ')'
        || ' | TripStarts=' || rec.trip_starts
        || ' | LatestStatus=' || CASE WHEN rec.status_time IS NULL THEN 'NO_STATUS' ELSE TO_CHAR(rec.status_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') END
        || ' | Bikes=' || CASE WHEN rec.bikes_available IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE rec.bikes_available END
        || ' | Docks=' || CASE WHEN rec.docks_available IS NULL THEN 'N/A' ELSE rec.docks_available END
      );
    END LOOP;

    IF lv_counter = 0 THEN
      -- Force the required NO_DATA_FOUND path for an empty result set.
      RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
    END IF;

  EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
    WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
  END print_landmark_station_ops;

END sf_bikeshare_ops_pkg;
/

Requirements:
Procedure Name: rpt_top_end_stations
Parameters:
p_start_station_name IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_station_name%TYPE
p_from_ts IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE
p_to_ts IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE
Output:
'Invalid input: start station name is required.'
'Invalid input: from timestamp is required.'
'Invalid input: to timestamp is required.'
'Invalid input: from timestamp must be <= to timestamp.'
'No trips found for given criteria.'
'Rank ' || rec.rn || ': ' || rec.end_station_name || ' | trips=' || rec.trip_cnt || ' | avg_duration_sec=' || rec.avg_dur_sec || ' | dominant_bucket=' || rec.dominant_bucket
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE rpt_top_end_stations(
  p_start_station_name IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_station_name%TYPE,
  p_from_ts            IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE,
  p_to_ts              IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  co_short_max_sec CONSTANT NUMBER := 600;  -- <= 10 minutes
  co_med_max_sec   CONSTANT NUMBER := 1800; -- 10-30 minutes

  lv_printed_rows  PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Input validation (no exceptions raised; print and exit)
  IF p_start_station_name IS NULL OR TRIM(p_start_station_name) IS NULL THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input: start station name is required.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF p_from_ts IS NULL THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input: from timestamp is required.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF p_to_ts IS NULL THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input: to timestamp is required.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF p_from_ts > p_to_ts THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input: from timestamp must be <= to timestamp.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Report: aggregate then rank end stations by trip count
  FOR rec IN (
    WITH filtered AS (
      SELECT
        t.end_station_name AS end_station_name,
        TO_NUMBER(t.duration_sec) AS dur_sec
      FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS t
      WHERE t.start_station_name = p_start_station_name
        AND t.start_date >= p_from_ts
        AND t.start_date < p_to_ts
        AND REGEXP_LIKE(t.duration_sec, '^\d+$')
        AND t.end_station_name IS NOT NULL
    ),
    agg AS (
      SELECT
        f.end_station_name,
        COUNT(*) AS trip_cnt,
        ROUND(AVG(f.dur_sec), 0) AS avg_dur_sec,
        SUM(CASE WHEN f.dur_sec <= co_short_max_sec THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS short_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN f.dur_sec > co_short_max_sec AND f.dur_sec <= co_med_max_sec THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS med_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN f.dur_sec > co_med_max_sec THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_cnt
      FROM filtered f
      GROUP BY f.end_station_name
    ),
    ranked AS (
      SELECT
        a.end_station_name,
        a.trip_cnt,
        a.avg_dur_sec,
        CASE
          WHEN a.short_cnt >= a.med_cnt AND a.short_cnt >= a.long_cnt THEN 'SHORT'
          WHEN a.med_cnt >= a.short_cnt AND a.med_cnt >= a.long_cnt THEN 'MEDIUM'
          ELSE 'LONG'
        END AS dominant_bucket,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.trip_cnt DESC, a.end_station_name ASC) AS rn
      FROM agg a
    )
    SELECT
      r.rn,
      r.end_station_name,
      r.trip_cnt,
      r.avg_dur_sec,
      r.dominant_bucket
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn <= co_report_limit
    ORDER BY r.rn
  ) LOOP
    lv_printed_rows := lv_printed_rows + 1;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'Rank ' || rec.rn || ': ' || rec.end_station_name ||
      ' | trips=' || rec.trip_cnt ||
      ' | avg_duration_sec=' || rec.avg_dur_sec ||
      ' | dominant_bucket=' || rec.dominant_bucket
    );
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_printed_rows = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No trips found for given criteria.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END rpt_top_end_stations;
/

DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_landmark SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS.landmark%TYPE := 'San Francisco';
  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  IF lv_landmark IS NULL THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Landmark must not be NULL.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Landmark = ' || lv_landmark);
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Top stations by trip starts (limited to ' || co_report_limit || ' rows):');

  FOR rec IN (
    WITH trip_counts AS (
      SELECT s.station_id,
             s.name AS station_name,
             COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trips_started
        FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS s
        LEFT JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_TRIPS t
          ON t.start_station_id = s.station_id
       WHERE s.landmark = lv_landmark
       GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name
    ),
    ranked AS (
      SELECT tc.station_id,
             tc.station_name,
             tc.trips_started,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tc.trips_started DESC, tc.station_name) AS rn
        FROM trip_counts tc
    ),
    latest_status AS (
      SELECT bs.station_id,
             bs.time AS latest_time,
             bs.bikes_available,
             bs.docks_available
        FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS bs
        INNER JOIN (
          SELECT station_id, MAX(time) AS max_time
            FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS
           GROUP BY station_id
        ) mx
          ON mx.station_id = bs.station_id
         AND mx.max_time = bs.time
    )
    SELECT r.rn,
           r.station_id,
           r.station_name,
           r.trips_started,
           ls.latest_time,
           ls.bikes_available,
           ls.docks_available
      FROM ranked r
      LEFT JOIN latest_status ls
        ON ls.station_id = r.station_id
     WHERE r.rn <= co_report_limit
     ORDER BY r.rn
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;

    IF rec.latest_time IS NOT NULL THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
        'Rank ' || rec.rn || ': ' || rec.station_name ||
        ' (station_id=' || rec.station_id || '), trips_started=' || rec.trips_started ||
        ', latest_status_time=' || rec.latest_time ||
        ', bikes=' || rec.bikes_available ||
        ', docks=' || rec.docks_available
      );
    ELSE
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
        'Rank ' || rec.rn || ': ' || rec.station_name ||
        ' (station_id=' || rec.station_id || '), trips_started=' || rec.trips_started ||
        ', No status snapshot'
      );
    END IF;
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No stations found for the provided landmark.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

 If an order has no currency rate information, treat the conversion rate as 1 and print a note in the line indicating the fallback was used.
 Validates that the date range is sensible (start <= end) and prints a user-friendly message if not.
 Handles missing data and unexpected issues gracefully via exception handling (no unhandled errors).

Requirements:
Procedure Name: report_order_totals_in_currency
Parameters:
p_start_date IN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER.orderdate%TYPE
p_end_date IN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER.orderdate%TYPE
p_to_currency_code IN ADVENTUREWORKS.CURRENCYRATE.tocurrencycode%TYPE
Output:
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid date range: start date is after end date.')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('SalesOrderID=' || r.salesorderid || ', OrderDate=' || TO_CHAR(r.orderdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ', TotalDue=' || TO_CHAR(r.totaldue) || ', FromCurrency=' || NVL(r.fromcurrencycode, 'N/A') || ', AvgRate=' || TO_CHAR(NVL(r.averagerate, 1)) || ', ConvertedTotalDue=' || TO_CHAR(r.totaldue * NVL(r.averagerate, 1)) || CASE WHEN r.averagerate IS NULL THEN ' (rate fallback=1)' ELSE '' END)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.')
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_order_totals_in_currency(
  p_start_date       IN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER.orderdate%TYPE,
  p_end_date         IN ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER.orderdate%TYPE,
  p_to_currency_code IN ADVENTUREWORKS.CURRENCYRATE.tocurrencycode%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Basic input validation
  IF p_start_date IS NOT NULL
     AND p_end_date IS NOT NULL
     AND p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid date range: start date is after end date.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Recent orders with optional currency rate info. If no rate is present, fallback rate=1.
  FOR r IN (
    SELECT
      soh.salesorderid,
      soh.orderdate,
      soh.totaldue,
      cr.fromcurrencycode,
      cr.averagerate
    FROM ADVENTUREWORKS.SALESORDERHEADER soh
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ADVENTUREWORKS.CURRENCYRATE cr
      ON cr.currencyrateid = soh.currencyrateid
     AND cr.tocurrencycode = p_to_currency_code
    WHERE soh.orderdate >= NVL(p_start_date, soh.orderdate)
      AND soh.orderdate <= NVL(p_end_date, soh.orderdate)
    ORDER BY soh.orderdate DESC, soh.salesorderid DESC
  ) LOOP
    EXIT WHEN lv_rows_printed >= co_report_limit;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'SalesOrderID=' || r.salesorderid ||
      ', OrderDate=' || TO_CHAR(r.orderdate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') ||
      ', TotalDue=' || TO_CHAR(r.totaldue) ||
      ', FromCurrency=' || NVL(r.fromcurrencycode, 'N/A') ||
      ', AvgRate=' || TO_CHAR(NVL(r.averagerate, 1)) ||
      ', ConvertedTotalDue=' || TO_CHAR(r.totaldue * NVL(r.averagerate, 1)) ||
      CASE WHEN r.averagerate IS NULL THEN ' (rate fallback=1)' ELSE '' END
    );

    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    -- Explicitly map the empty result set to the standard NO_DATA_FOUND handler.
    RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_order_totals_in_currency;
/

  If station status is missing for a station, treat available bikes/docks as zero and label risk accordingly.
  If capacity is missing or non-numeric/zero, avoid divide-by-zero and label the station as “CAPACITY_UNKNOWN”.

Parameters:
p_start_ts IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE bikeshare_ops_pkg IS
  PROCEDURE print_utilization_risk(
    p_start_ts IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE,
    p_end_ts   IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.end_date%TYPE
  );
END bikeshare_ops_pkg;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE BODY bikeshare_ops_pkg IS

  PROCEDURE print_utilization_risk(
    p_start_ts IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE,
    p_end_ts   IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.end_date%TYPE
  ) IS
    co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

    lv_has_rows PLS_INTEGER;
  BEGIN
    IF p_start_ts IS NULL OR p_end_ts IS NULL OR p_end_ts < p_start_ts THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input.');
      RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- Guard clause: ensure the period has at least one trip before printing headers.
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO lv_has_rows
      FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS t
     WHERE t.start_date >= p_start_ts
       AND t.start_date < p_end_ts;

    IF lv_has_rows = 0 THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
      RETURN;
    END IF;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Utilization risk report');
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Period: ' || TO_CHAR(p_start_ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') || ' to ' || TO_CHAR(p_end_ts, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'));
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('Station', 35) || ' | ' || RPAD('Region', 18) || ' | Trips | Cap | Bikes | Docks | Risk');
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('-', 35, '-') || '-+-' || RPAD('-', 18, '-') || '-+------+-+----+------+-------+----------------');

    -- Main report:
    -- 1) Aggregate trips by start station.
    -- 2) Rank by volume using ROW_NUMBER to deterministically select the top N.
    -- 3) Enrich with station/region and current status.
    FOR rec IN (
      WITH trip_counts AS (
        SELECT t.start_station_id,
               COUNT(*) AS trip_cnt
          FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS t
         WHERE t.start_date >= p_start_ts
           AND t.start_date < p_end_ts
         GROUP BY t.start_station_id
      ),
      ranked AS (
        SELECT tc.start_station_id,
               tc.trip_cnt,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tc.trip_cnt DESC, tc.start_station_id) AS rn
          FROM trip_counts tc
      ),
      topn AS (
        SELECT r.start_station_id,
               r.trip_cnt
          FROM ranked r
         WHERE r.rn <= co_report_limit
      )
      SELECT si.name AS station_name,
             rg.name AS region_name,
             tn.trip_cnt,
             CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(si.capacity, '^\s*[0-9]+\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(si.capacity))
               ELSE NULL
             END AS capacity_num,
             CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(ss.num_bikes_available, '^\s*[0-9]+\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(ss.num_bikes_available))
               ELSE 0
             END AS bikes_avail,
             CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(ss.num_docks_available, '^\s*[0-9]+\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(ss.num_docks_available))
               ELSE 0
             END AS docks_avail,
             CASE
               WHEN (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(si.capacity, '^\s*[0-9]+\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(si.capacity)) END) IS NULL
                    OR (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(si.capacity, '^\s*[0-9]+\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(si.capacity)) END) = 0
                 THEN 'CAPACITY_UNKNOWN'
               WHEN (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(ss.num_bikes_available, '^\s*[0-9]+\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(ss.num_bikes_available)) ELSE 0 END)
                    / (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(si.capacity, '^\s*[0-9]+\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(si.capacity)) END) <= 0.10
                 THEN 'BIKES_CRITICALLY_LOW'
               WHEN (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(ss.num_docks_available, '^\s*[0-9]+\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(ss.num_docks_available)) ELSE 0 END)
                    / (CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(si.capacity, '^\s*[0-9]+\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(si.capacity)) END) <= 0.10
                 THEN 'DOCKS_CRITICALLY_LOW'
               ELSE 'OK'
             END AS risk_label
        FROM topn tn
        INNER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
          ON si.station_id = tn.start_station_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS rg
          ON rg.region_id = si.region_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_STATUS ss
          ON ss.station_id = si.station_id
       ORDER BY tn.trip_cnt DESC, si.station_id
    ) LOOP
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
        RPAD(rec.station_name, 35) || ' | ' ||
        RPAD(rec.region_name, 18) || ' | ' ||
        LPAD(rec.trip_cnt, 5) || ' | ' ||
        LPAD(NVL(TO_CHAR(rec.capacity_num), '?'), 3) || ' | ' ||
        LPAD(rec.bikes_avail, 4) || ' | ' ||
        LPAD(rec.docks_avail, 5) || ' | ' ||
        rec.risk_label
      );
    END LOOP;

  EXCEPTION
    WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
    WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input.');
    WHEN OTHERS THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
  END print_utilization_risk;

END bikeshare_ops_pkg;
/

Parameters:
p_calendar_year IN COMPLEX_ORACLE.TIMES.calendar_year%TYPE
p_top_n IN NUMBER
Output:

DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('PROD_NAME', 35) || ' | ' || LPAD('AMT', 12) || ' | ' || LPAD('QTY', 10) || ' | ' || LPAD('WAVG_PRICE', 12) || ' | ' || 'FLAG');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('-', 35, '-') || '-+-' || LPAD('-', 12, '-') || '-+-' || LPAD('-', 10, '-') || '-+-' || LPAD('-', 12, '-') || '-+-' || RPAD('-', 10, '-'));
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD(rec.prod_name, 35) || ' | ' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.total_amt, '9999999990D00'), 12) || ' | ' || LPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.total_qty), 10) || ' | ' || LPAD(CASE WHEN rec.wavg_unit_price IS NULL THEN 'NULL' ELSE TO_CHAR(rec.wavg_unit_price, '9999999990D00') END, 12) || ' | ' || rec.price_flag);
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_top_products_by_year(
  p_calendar_year IN COMPLEX_ORACLE.TIMES.calendar_year%TYPE,
  p_top_n         IN NUMBER
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_top_n        PLS_INTEGER;
  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;

  CURSOR c_top_products IS
    WITH prod_totals AS (
      SELECT s.prod_id,
             SUM(s.amount_sold)   AS total_amt,
             SUM(s.quantity_sold) AS total_qty
        FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s
        INNER JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.TIMES t
          ON t.time_id = s.time_id
       WHERE t.calendar_year = p_calendar_year
       GROUP BY s.prod_id
    ),
    ranked AS (
      SELECT p.prod_name,
             pt.total_amt,
             pt.total_qty,
             CASE
               WHEN pt.total_qty = 0 THEN NULL
               ELSE pt.total_amt / pt.total_qty
             END AS wavg_unit_price,
             CASE
               WHEN pt.total_qty = 0 THEN 'OK'
               WHEN (pt.total_amt / pt.total_qty) > p.prod_list_price THEN 'HIGH_PRICE'
               ELSE 'OK'
             END AS price_flag,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pt.total_amt DESC, p.prod_name ASC) AS rn
        FROM prod_totals pt
        INNER JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.PRODUCTS p
          ON p.prod_id = pt.prod_id
    )
    SELECT r.prod_name,
           r.total_amt,
           r.total_qty,
           r.wavg_unit_price,
           r.price_flag
      FROM ranked r
     WHERE r.rn <= lv_top_n
     ORDER BY r.rn;

BEGIN
  lv_top_n := LEAST(co_report_limit, NVL(p_top_n, co_report_limit));

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Top products for year ' || p_calendar_year || ' (showing up to ' || lv_top_n || '):');
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('PROD_NAME', 35) || ' | ' || LPAD('AMT', 12) || ' | ' || LPAD('QTY', 10) || ' | ' || LPAD('WAVG_PRICE', 12) || ' | ' || 'FLAG');
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('-', 35, '-') || '-+-' || LPAD('-', 12, '-') || '-+-' || LPAD('-', 10, '-') || '-+-' || LPAD('-', 12, '-') || '-+-' || RPAD('-', 10, '-'));

  FOR rec IN c_top_products LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      RPAD(rec.prod_name, 35) || ' | ' ||
      LPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.total_amt, '9999999990D00'), 12) || ' | ' ||
      LPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.total_qty), 10) || ' | ' ||
      LPAD(
        CASE
          WHEN rec.wavg_unit_price IS NULL THEN 'NULL'
          ELSE TO_CHAR(rec.wavg_unit_price, '9999999990D00')
        END,
        12
      ) || ' | ' || rec.price_flag
    );
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_top_products_by_year;
/

Build a reusable reporting routine for the pizza operations team.

They want a procedure that, for a given runner, prints up to 15 of that runner’s most recent completed deliveries (i.e., not cancelled). For each delivery, show the order id, pickup time (as stored), distance and duration, and also translate each pizza in the order into its pizza name so the team can spot patterns. If an order has multiple pizzas, print each pizza as a separate line under the same order id.

Add basic input validation (runner id must not be null) and make sure the routine never crashes: it should print clear messages when there is no data, or when something unexpected happens.

Requirements:

Parameters:
p_runner_id IN MODERN_DATA.PIZZA_RUNNER_ORDERS.runner_id%TYPE
Output:
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Runner delivery report for runner_id=' || p_runner_id);
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('OrderId=' || rec.order_id || ' | PickupTime=' || rec.pickup_time || ' | Distance=' || rec.distance || ' | Duration=' || rec.duration || ' | Pizza=' || rec.pizza_name);
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No completed deliveries found for runner_id=' || p_runner_id);
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Runner id is required.');
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_runner_recent_deliveries(
  p_runner_id IN MODERN_DATA.PIZZA_RUNNER_ORDERS.runner_id%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_runner_id IS NULL THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Runner id is required.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Runner delivery report for runner_id=' || p_runner_id);

  -- Print most recent completed deliveries (not cancelled). Each pizza in the order prints as its own line.
  FOR rec IN (
    WITH completed AS (
      SELECT
        pro.order_id,
        pro.pickup_time,
        pro.distance,
        pro.duration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pro.order_id ORDER BY pro.order_id) AS rn_per_order
      FROM MODERN_DATA.PIZZA_RUNNER_ORDERS pro
      WHERE pro.runner_id = p_runner_id
        AND pro.cancellation IS NULL
    ),
    recent_orders AS (
      SELECT
        c.order_id,
        c.pickup_time,
        c.distance,
        c.duration,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.order_id DESC) AS rn_recent
      FROM completed c
      WHERE c.rn_per_order = 1
    )
    SELECT
      ro.order_id,
      ro.pickup_time,
      ro.distance,
      ro.duration,
      pn.pizza_name
    FROM recent_orders ro
    INNER JOIN MODERN_DATA.PIZZA_CLEAN_CUSTOMER_ORDERS pcco
      ON pcco.order_id = ro.order_id
    INNER JOIN MODERN_DATA.PIZZA_NAMES pn
      ON pn.pizza_id = pcco.pizza_id
    WHERE ro.rn_recent <= co_report_limit
    ORDER BY ro.order_id DESC, pn.pizza_name
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'OrderId=' || rec.order_id ||
      ' | PickupTime=' || rec.pickup_time ||
      ' | Distance=' || rec.distance ||
      ' | Duration=' || rec.duration ||
      ' | Pizza=' || rec.pizza_name
    );
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No completed deliveries found for runner_id=' || p_runner_id);
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_runner_recent_deliveries;
/

As a quick match-day check, print a small “scoreboard slice” for a given match and innings:
 Summarize total batsman runs and total extras per over.
 Print up to 15 overs, ordered by over number.
 For each over, also classify the over as HIGH (>= 10 total runs in the over) or LOW (< 10).
 If the match/innings combination has no deliveries, show a single informative message rather than failing.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: Anonymous Block.
Parameters: None.
Output: DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Match ' || lv_match_id || ', Innings ' || lv_innings_no || ' - Over ' || rec.over_id || ': batsman=' || rec.batsman_runs || ', extras=' || rec.extra_runs || ', total=' || rec.total_runs || ' (' || rec.over_band || ')');
Output: DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No overs found for match/innings.');
Exception Handling: WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No overs found for match/innings.'.
Exception Handling: WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'.
Exception Handling: WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'.
reference_answer:
DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_match_id   IPL.BATSMAN_SCORED.match_id%TYPE;
  lv_innings_no IPL.BATSMAN_SCORED.innings_no%TYPE;

  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  /* Pick a real match/innings pair deterministically (most common in ball data). */
  SELECT match_id, innings_no
    INTO lv_match_id, lv_innings_no
    FROM (
      SELECT bs.match_id, bs.innings_no
        FROM IPL.BATSMAN_SCORED bs
       GROUP BY bs.match_id, bs.innings_no
       ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, bs.match_id, bs.innings_no
    )
   WHERE ROWNUM = 1;

  /* Print per-over summary: batsman runs, extras, total, and a simple banding rule. */
  FOR rec IN (
    SELECT over_id,
           batsman_runs,
           extra_runs,
           (batsman_runs + extra_runs) AS total_runs,
           CASE
             WHEN (batsman_runs + extra_runs) >= 10 THEN 'HIGH'
             ELSE 'LOW'
           END AS over_band
      FROM (
        SELECT bs.over_id,
               SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS batsman_runs,
               NVL((SELECT SUM(er.extra_runs)
                      FROM IPL.EXTRA_RUNS er
                     WHERE er.match_id = lv_match_id
                       AND er.innings_no = lv_innings_no
                       AND er.over_id = bs.over_id), 0) AS extra_runs
          FROM IPL.BATSMAN_SCORED bs
         WHERE bs.match_id = lv_match_id
           AND bs.innings_no = lv_innings_no
         GROUP BY bs.over_id
         ORDER BY bs.over_id
      )
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
     ORDER BY over_id
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'Match ' || lv_match_id || ', Innings ' || lv_innings_no ||
      ' - Over ' || rec.over_id ||
      ': batsman=' || rec.batsman_runs ||
      ', extras=' || rec.extra_runs ||
      ', total=' || rec.total_runs ||
      ' (' || rec.over_band || ')'
    );
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No overs found for match/innings.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No overs found for match/innings.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

Operations wants a small, reusable reporting routine for bike availability. Build a stored procedure that takes a landmark name (e.g., “San Francisco”) and prints up to 15 bikeshare stations in that landmark with their latest known timestamp and bikes/docks available.

Business rules:
 If the landmark parameter is NULL or blank, print a clear message and stop.
 “Latest known status” means the status row with the maximum TIME for each station.
 Only show stations that have a matching latest status row.
 Print one line per station in a readable format.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: report_bikeshare_latest_status
Parameters:
p_landmark IN SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS.landmark%TYPE
Output:
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Landmark is required.');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Station: ' || rec.station_name || ' | AsOf: ' || TO_CHAR(rec.asof_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' | Bikes: ' || rec.bikes_avail || ' | Docks: ' || rec.docks_avail);
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_bikeshare_latest_status(
  p_landmark IN SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS.landmark%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
BEGIN
  -- Guard clause for required parameter
  IF p_landmark IS NULL OR TRIM(p_landmark) IS NULL THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Landmark is required.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Print latest status per station for the given landmark
  FOR rec IN (
    WITH latest_status AS (
      SELECT bs.station_id,
             MAX(bs.time) AS max_time
        FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS bs
       GROUP BY bs.station_id
    )
    SELECT s.name AS station_name,
           st.time AS asof_time,
           st.bikes_available AS bikes_avail,
           st.docks_available AS docks_avail
      FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS s
      INNER JOIN latest_status ls
        ON ls.station_id = s.station_id
      INNER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS st
        ON st.station_id = ls.station_id
       AND st.time = ls.max_time
     WHERE s.landmark = p_landmark
       AND ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
     ORDER BY s.name
  ) LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'Station: ' || rec.station_name ||
      ' | AsOf: ' || TO_CHAR(rec.asof_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') ||
      ' | Bikes: ' || rec.bikes_avail ||
      ' | Docks: ' || rec.docks_avail
    );
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_bikeshare_latest_status;

question:
Your analytics team needs a reusable reporting routine for Medicare Home Health Agencies.

Build a stored procedure that takes a US state code and prints up to 15 agencies in that state, ranked by the highest Medicare payment amount (non-LUPA). For each agency, display provider id, agency name, city, and the Medicare payment amount (converted safely from the VARCHAR2 column).

Business rules:
 Treat blank/NULL/non-numeric payment values as 0.
 If the caller passes NULL or an invalid state code (not exactly 2 characters), print a clear message and stop.
 If the state has no matching agencies, print a clear message.
 Use a loop to print the ranked rows, and include the rank number in the output.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: report_hha_top_payments
Parameters:
 p_state IN CMS_MEDICARE.HOME_HEALTH_AGENCIES.state%TYPE
Output:
 DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid state input: ' || NVL(p_state, 'NULL'))
 DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No agencies found for state: ' || p_state)
 DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(LPAD(l_rank, 2, '0') || '. ' || rec.provider_id || ' | ' || rec.agency_name || ' | ' || rec.city || ', ' || rec.state || ' | MedicarePay=' || TO_CHAR(rec.medicare_pay, 'FM999G999G999G999G990D00'))
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_hha_top_payments(
  p_state IN CMS_MEDICARE.HOME_HEALTH_AGENCIES.state%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  l_rank PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Basic input validation (must be exactly 2 characters)
  IF p_state IS NULL OR LENGTH(TRIM(p_state)) <> 2 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid state input: ' || NVL(p_state, 'NULL'));
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- If no rows exist for the state, print a clear message and stop.
  DECLARE
    l_cnt PLS_INTEGER;
  BEGIN
    SELECT COUNT(*)
      INTO l_cnt
      FROM CMS_MEDICARE.HOME_HEALTH_AGENCIES h
     WHERE h.state = TRIM(p_state);

    IF l_cnt = 0 THEN
      DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No agencies found for state: ' || p_state);
      RETURN;
    END IF;
  END;

  -- Rank and print up to 15 agencies by payment amount (non-LUPA)
  FOR rec IN (
    WITH ranked AS (
      SELECT h.provider_id,
             h.agency_name,
             h.city,
             h.state,
             CASE
               WHEN h.total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa IS NULL OR TRIM(h.total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa) IS NULL THEN 0
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(h.total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa), '^[+-]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
                 THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(h.total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa))
               ELSE 0
             END AS medicare_pay,
             ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               ORDER BY
                 CASE
                   WHEN h.total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa IS NULL OR TRIM(h.total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa) IS NULL THEN 0
                   WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(h.total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa), '^[+-]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')
                     THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(h.total_hha_medicare_payment_amount_non_lupa))
                   ELSE 0
                 END DESC,
                 h.provider_id
             ) AS rn
        FROM CMS_MEDICARE.HOME_HEALTH_AGENCIES h
       WHERE h.state = TRIM(p_state)
    )
    SELECT r.provider_id,
           r.agency_name,
           r.city,
           r.state,
           r.medicare_pay
      FROM ranked r
     WHERE r.rn <= co_report_limit
     ORDER BY r.rn
  ) LOOP
    l_rank := l_rank + 1;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      LPAD(l_rank, 2, '0') || '. ' ||
      rec.provider_id || ' | ' ||
      rec.agency_name || ' | ' ||
      rec.city || ', ' || rec.state || ' | MedicarePay=' ||
      TO_CHAR(rec.medicare_pay, 'FM999G999G999G999G990D00')
    );
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_hha_top_payments;
/

Your HR analytics team wants a quick console report that compares Google's US intersectional representation vs exits for a single report year.

Write an anonymous PL/SQL block that:
Accepts a report year (as a VARCHAR2(4) variable in the DECLARE section).
Pulls up to 15 rows for that year by joining representation to exits on the same workforce + gender + race attributes.
For each matched row, prints the workforce, gender, and the five race flags, and also prints whether the row is "Representation only", "Exits only", or "Both" (based on whether each side exists).
Includes basic validation: if the year is NULL or not 4 characters, print a message and stop.
Uses exception handling so the script never errors at runtime; print clear messages for NO_DATA_FOUND, TOO_MANY_ROWS, and OTHERS.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: Anonymous Block
Parameters: None
Output: DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid year. Provide a 4-character report year.');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('WORKFORCE=' || rec.workforce || '; GENDER=' || rec.gender_us || '; ASIAN=' || rec.race_asian || '; BLACK=' || rec.race_black || '; HISPANIC_LATINX=' || rec.race_hispanic_latinx || '; NATIVE_AMERICAN=' || rec.race_native_american || '; WHITE=' || rec.race_white || '; STATUS=' || rec.status);
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No matching data for year ' || lv_year || '.');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
Exception Handling: WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No matching data for year ' || lv_year || '.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
DECLARE
  lv_year  GOOGLE_DEI.DAR_INTERSECTIONAL_REPRESENTATION.report_year%TYPE := '2022';
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability
  lv_rows PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Basic input validation
  IF lv_year IS NULL OR LENGTH(lv_year) <> 4 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid year. Provide a 4-character report year.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Show up to 15 matched rows across representation and exits for the same year
  FOR rec IN (
    SELECT
      COALESCE(r.workforce, e.workforce) AS workforce,
      COALESCE(r.gender_us, e.gender_us) AS gender_us,
      COALESCE(r.race_asian, e.race_asian) AS race_asian,
      COALESCE(r.race_black, e.race_black) AS race_black,
      COALESCE(r.race_hispanic_latinx, e.race_hispanic_latinx) AS race_hispanic_latinx,
      COALESCE(r.race_native_american, e.race_native_american) AS race_native_american,
      COALESCE(r.race_white, e.race_white) AS race_white,
      CASE
        WHEN r.workforce IS NOT NULL AND e.workforce IS NOT NULL THEN 'Both'
        WHEN r.workforce IS NOT NULL AND e.workforce IS NULL THEN 'Representation only'
        WHEN r.workforce IS NULL AND e.workforce IS NOT NULL THEN 'Exits only'
        ELSE 'Unknown'
      END AS status
    FROM GOOGLE_DEI.DAR_INTERSECTIONAL_REPRESENTATION r
    FULL OUTER JOIN GOOGLE_DEI.DAR_INTERSECTIONAL_EXITS_REPRESENTATION e
      ON e.report_year = r.report_year
     AND e.workforce = r.workforce
     AND e.gender_us = r.gender_us
     AND e.race_asian = r.race_asian
     AND e.race_black = r.race_black
     AND e.race_hispanic_latinx = r.race_hispanic_latinx
     AND e.race_native_american = r.race_native_american
     AND e.race_white = r.race_white
    WHERE r.report_year = lv_year
       OR e.report_year = lv_year
    ORDER BY
      COALESCE(r.workforce, e.workforce),
      COALESCE(r.gender_us, e.gender_us)
    FETCH FIRST co_report_limit ROWS ONLY
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows := lv_rows + 1;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'WORKFORCE=' || rec.workforce ||
      '; GENDER=' || rec.gender_us ||
      '; ASIAN=' || rec.race_asian ||
      '; BLACK=' || rec.race_black ||
      '; HISPANIC_LATINX=' || rec.race_hispanic_latinx ||
      '; NATIVE_AMERICAN=' || rec.race_native_american ||
      '; WHITE=' || rec.race_white ||
      '; STATUS=' || rec.status
    );
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows = 0 THEN
    RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No matching data for year ' || lv_year || '.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;

DECLARE
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_station_name SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS.name%TYPE := 'Townsend at 7th';
  lv_station_id   SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS.station_id%TYPE;

  lv_clean_name   SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS.name%TYPE;
BEGIN
  -- Guard clause for missing/blank station name
  lv_clean_name := TRIM(lv_station_name);
  IF lv_clean_name IS NULL THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No station name provided.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Resolve station_id for the provided station name
  SELECT s.station_id
    INTO lv_station_id
    FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATIONS s
   WHERE s.name = lv_clean_name;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Station Report for: ' || lv_station_name || ' (station_id=' || lv_station_id || ')');

  -- Most recent snapshots with safe numeric conversion and a simple operational classification
  FOR rec IN (
    WITH latest_status AS (
      SELECT st.time,
             CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(st.bikes_available, '^\s*\d+\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(st.bikes_available))
               ELSE 0
             END AS bikes_available_num,
             CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(st.docks_available, '^\s*\d+\s*$') THEN TO_NUMBER(TRIM(st.docks_available))
               ELSE 0
             END AS docks_available_num,
             CASE
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(st.docks_available, '^\s*\d+\s*$')
                    AND TO_NUMBER(TRIM(st.docks_available)) = 0 THEN 'FULL'
               WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(st.bikes_available, '^\s*\d+\s*$')
                    AND TO_NUMBER(TRIM(st.bikes_available)) = 0 THEN 'EMPTY'
               ELSE 'BALANCED'
             END AS station_state
        FROM SAN_FRANCISCO.BIKESHARE_STATUS st
       WHERE st.station_id = lv_station_id
       ORDER BY st.time DESC
    )
    SELECT ls.time,
           ls.bikes_available_num,
           ls.docks_available_num,
           ls.station_state
      FROM latest_status ls
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
     ORDER BY ls.time DESC
  ) LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      TO_CHAR(rec.time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') ||
      ' | bikes=' || rec.bikes_available_num ||
      ' | docks=' || rec.docks_available_num ||
      ' | state=' || rec.station_state
    );
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END;
/

  If docks available = 0 and bikes available > 0 => 'FULL'
  If bikes available = 0 and docks available > 0 => 'EMPTY'
  Else => 'BALANCED'

 Use control flow to validate that the time window is sensible (start < end). If it is not, the procedure must print a message and exit without raising an error.
 Exception handling must be robust and must never allow a runtime error to escape.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: report_region_station_rank
Parameters:
p_region_name IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS.name%TYPE
p_window_start IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE
p_window_end IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE
Output:
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid time window: start must be earlier than end.')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Station Trip Volume Report')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Region Filter: ' || NVL(p_region_name, 'ALL'))
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Window: ' || TO_CHAR(p_window_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' to ' || TO_CHAR(p_window_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('Rank', 6) || RPAD('Station', 40) || RPAD('Trips', 10) || RPAD('Bikes', 8) || RPAD('Docks', 8) || 'Utilization')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('-', 6, '-') || RPAD('-', 40, '-') || RPAD('-', 10, '-') || RPAD('-', 8, '-') || RPAD('-', 8, '-') || RPAD('-', 12, '-'))
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.rnk), 6) || RPAD(rec.station_name, 40) || RPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.trip_cnt), 10) || RPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.bikes_avail), 8) || RPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.docks_avail), 8) || rec.utilization)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No stations matched the criteria.')
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_region_station_rank(
  p_region_name  IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS.name%TYPE,
  p_window_start IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE,
  p_window_end   IN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS.start_date%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Control-flow validation for the time window
  IF p_window_start IS NULL OR p_window_end IS NULL OR p_window_start >= p_window_end THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid time window: start must be earlier than end.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Station Trip Volume Report');
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Region Filter: ' || NVL(p_region_name, 'ALL'));
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
    'Window: ' || TO_CHAR(p_window_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' to ' || TO_CHAR(p_window_end, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
  );
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('Rank', 6) || RPAD('Station', 40) || RPAD('Trips', 10) || RPAD('Bikes', 8) || RPAD('Docks', 8) || 'Utilization');
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('-', 6, '-') || RPAD('-', 40, '-') || RPAD('-', 10, '-') || RPAD('-', 8, '-') || RPAD('-', 8, '-') || RPAD('-', 12, '-'));

  -- Report query: rank stations by trip starts in the window.
  -- Include stations with no status by LEFT JOIN and treat missing status as 0.
  FOR rec IN (
    WITH station_trips AS (
      SELECT
        si.station_id,
        si.name AS station_name,
        COUNT(*) AS trip_cnt
      FROM SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_INFO si
      INNER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_TRIPS t
        ON t.start_station_id = si.station_id
      LEFT OUTER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_REGIONS r
        ON r.region_id = si.region_id
      WHERE t.start_date >= p_window_start
        AND t.start_date <  p_window_end
        AND (p_region_name IS NULL OR r.name = p_region_name)
      GROUP BY si.station_id, si.name
    ), ranked AS (
      SELECT
        st.station_id,
        st.station_name,
        st.trip_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY st.trip_cnt DESC, st.station_name ASC) AS rnk
      FROM station_trips st
    )
    SELECT
      rk.rnk,
      rk.station_name,
      rk.trip_cnt,
      NVL(TO_NUMBER(ss.num_bikes_available), 0) AS bikes_avail,
      NVL(TO_NUMBER(ss.num_docks_available), 0) AS docks_avail,
      CASE
        WHEN NVL(TO_NUMBER(ss.num_docks_available), 0) = 0
             AND NVL(TO_NUMBER(ss.num_bikes_available), 0) > 0 THEN 'FULL'
        WHEN NVL(TO_NUMBER(ss.num_bikes_available), 0) = 0
             AND NVL(TO_NUMBER(ss.num_docks_available), 0) > 0 THEN 'EMPTY'
        ELSE 'BALANCED'
      END AS utilization
    FROM ranked rk
    LEFT OUTER JOIN SAN_FRANCISCO_BIKESHARE.BIKESHARE_STATION_STATUS ss
      ON ss.station_id = rk.station_id
    WHERE rk.rnk <= co_report_limit
    ORDER BY rk.rnk
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      RPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.rnk), 6) ||
      RPAD(rec.station_name, 40) ||
      RPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.trip_cnt), 10) ||
      RPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.bikes_avail), 8) ||
      RPAD(TO_CHAR(rec.docks_avail), 8) ||
      rec.utilization
    );
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No stations matched the criteria.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_region_station_rank;
/

question:
Build a reusable stored procedure for operations reporting that reviews delivery performance by hub and channel for a given date range.

The procedure should:
 Validate the input timestamps and stop early with a clear message if the range is invalid.
 For the given time window, print up to 15 hub+channel combinations ranked by the highest delivery completion rate (Delivered deliveries / all deliveries), using a deterministic tie-breaker.
 For each printed row, include: hub name, hub city/state, channel name/type, total orders, total deliveries, delivered deliveries, completion rate %, and average delivery distance in meters.
 Handle edge cases gracefully (no matching data, null inputs, and unexpected errors) without raising exceptions to the caller.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: report_hub_channel_delivery_kpis
Parameters:
  p_start_ts IN DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS.order_moment_created%TYPE
  p_end_ts IN DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS.order_moment_created%TYPE
Output:
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid time window: start timestamp must be <= end timestamp.')
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found for the given time window.')
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('HUB=' || rec.hub_name || ' (' || rec.hub_city || '/' || rec.hub_state || ') | CHANNEL=' || rec.channel_name || ' [' || rec.channel_type || '] | ORDERS=' || rec.total_orders || ' | DELIVERIES=' || rec.total_deliveries || ' | DELIVERED=' || rec.delivered_deliveries || ' | COMPLETION_RATE_PCT=' || TO_CHAR(rec.completion_rate_pct, 'FM990D00') || ' | AVG_DISTANCE_M=' || TO_CHAR(rec.avg_distance_meters, 'FM999999990D00'))
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.')
Exception Handling:
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found for the given time window.'
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
  WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_hub_channel_delivery_kpis(
  p_start_ts IN DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS.order_moment_created%TYPE,
  p_end_ts   IN DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS.order_moment_created%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  -- Basic input validation (NULLs and invalid range)
  IF p_start_ts IS NULL OR p_end_ts IS NULL OR p_start_ts > p_end_ts THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid time window: start timestamp must be <= end timestamp.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- Rank hub+channel pairs by completion rate (Delivered / Total deliveries), then deterministic tie-breakers.
  FOR rec IN (
    WITH base AS (
      SELECT
        h.hub_name,
        h.hub_city,
        h.hub_state,
        c.channel_name,
        c.channel_type,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS total_deliveries,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.delivery_status = 'delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_deliveries,
        AVG(d.delivery_distance_meters) AS avg_distance_meters
      FROM DELIVERY_CENTER.orders o
      INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.stores s
        ON s.store_id = o.store_id
      INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.hubs h
        ON h.hub_id = s.hub_id
      INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.channels c
        ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id
      LEFT OUTER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.deliveries d
        ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
      WHERE o.order_moment_created >= p_start_ts
        AND o.order_moment_created <= p_end_ts
      GROUP BY
        h.hub_name,
        h.hub_city,
        h.hub_state,
        c.channel_name,
        c.channel_type
    ), ranked AS (
      SELECT
        b.hub_name,
        b.hub_city,
        b.hub_state,
        b.channel_name,
        b.channel_type,
        b.total_orders,
        b.total_deliveries,
        b.delivered_deliveries,
        b.avg_distance_meters,
        CASE
          WHEN b.total_deliveries = 0 THEN 0
          ELSE (b.delivered_deliveries * 100) / b.total_deliveries
        END AS completion_rate_pct,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          ORDER BY
            CASE
              WHEN b.total_deliveries = 0 THEN 0
              ELSE (b.delivered_deliveries * 100) / b.total_deliveries
            END DESC,
            b.total_deliveries DESC,
            b.hub_name ASC,
            b.channel_name ASC
        ) AS rn
      FROM base b
    )
    SELECT
      r.hub_name,
      r.hub_city,
      r.hub_state,
      r.channel_name,
      r.channel_type,
      r.total_orders,
      r.total_deliveries,
      r.delivered_deliveries,
      r.completion_rate_pct,
      r.avg_distance_meters
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn <= co_report_limit
    ORDER BY r.rn
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'HUB=' || rec.hub_name || ' (' || rec.hub_city || '/' || rec.hub_state || ') | ' ||
      'CHANNEL=' || rec.channel_name || ' [' || rec.channel_type || '] | ' ||
      'ORDERS=' || rec.total_orders || ' | ' ||
      'DELIVERIES=' || rec.total_deliveries || ' | ' ||
      'DELIVERED=' || rec.delivered_deliveries || ' | ' ||
      'COMPLETION_RATE_PCT=' || TO_CHAR(rec.completion_rate_pct, 'FM990D00') || ' | ' ||
      'AVG_DISTANCE_M=' || TO_CHAR(rec.avg_distance_meters, 'FM999999990D00')
    );
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found for the given time window.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found for the given time window.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_hub_channel_delivery_kpis;
/

Use an explicit named cursor to iterate over the ranked result set.
Use control flow so that if the year input is NULL (or the “top N” input is NULL or <= 0), the procedure prints a clear message and exits.
Include exception handling so the procedure never raises an unhandled runtime error.
Keep output small: do not print more than 15 rows.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: report_top_customers_by_channel
Parameters:
p_calendar_year IN COMPLEX_ORACLE.TIMES.calendar_year%TYPE
p_min_amount IN COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES.amount_sold%TYPE
p_top_n IN NUMBER
Output:
'Invalid input: calendar year is required.'
'Invalid input: top N must be a positive number.'
'No results found for the given criteria.'
'CHANNEL=' || r.channel_desc || ' | CUSTOMER=' || r.cust_last_name || ', ' || r.cust_first_name || ' | YEAR=' || TO_CHAR(p_calendar_year) || ' | TOTAL_AMOUNT=' || TO_CHAR(r.total_amount) || ' | RANK_IN_CHANNEL=' || TO_CHAR(r.rnk_in_channel)
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No results found for the given criteria.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_top_customers_by_channel(
  p_calendar_year IN COMPLEX_ORACLE.TIMES.calendar_year%TYPE,
  p_min_amount    IN COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES.amount_sold%TYPE,
  p_top_n         IN NUMBER
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  CURSOR cur_ranked IS
    WITH cust_channel_totals AS (
      SELECT ch.channel_desc,
             cu.cust_first_name,
             cu.cust_last_name,
             SUM(s.amount_sold) AS total_amount
        FROM COMPLEX_ORACLE.SALES s
        INNER JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.TIMES t
          ON t.time_id = s.time_id
        INNER JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.CHANNELS ch
          ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
        INNER JOIN COMPLEX_ORACLE.CUSTOMERS cu
          ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
       WHERE t.calendar_year = p_calendar_year
       GROUP BY ch.channel_desc,
                cu.cust_first_name,
                cu.cust_last_name
    ), ranked AS (
      SELECT cct.channel_desc,
             cct.cust_first_name,
             cct.cust_last_name,
             cct.total_amount,
             RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY cct.channel_desc
               ORDER BY cct.total_amount DESC
             ) AS rnk_in_channel
        FROM cust_channel_totals cct
       WHERE cct.total_amount >= NVL(p_min_amount, 0)
    )
    SELECT r.channel_desc,
           r.cust_first_name,
           r.cust_last_name,
           r.total_amount,
           r.rnk_in_channel
      FROM ranked r
     WHERE r.rnk_in_channel <= p_top_n
       AND ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
     ORDER BY r.channel_desc, r.rnk_in_channel, r.total_amount DESC;

  lv_printed_rows PLS_INTEGER := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_calendar_year IS NULL THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input: calendar year is required.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF p_top_n IS NULL OR p_top_n <= 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input: top N must be a positive number.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  FOR r IN cur_ranked LOOP
    lv_printed_rows := lv_printed_rows + 1;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'CHANNEL=' || r.channel_desc ||
      ' | CUSTOMER=' || r.cust_last_name || ', ' || r.cust_first_name ||
      ' | YEAR=' || TO_CHAR(p_calendar_year) ||
      ' | TOTAL_AMOUNT=' || TO_CHAR(r.total_amount) ||
      ' | RANK_IN_CHANNEL=' || TO_CHAR(r.rnk_in_channel)
    );
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_printed_rows = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No results found for the given criteria.');
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No results found for the given criteria.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_top_customers_by_channel;
/

WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_runner_delivery_kpis(
  p_runner_id IN MODERN_DATA.PIZZA_RUNNER_ORDERS.runner_id%TYPE DEFAULT NULL
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_rows_printed PLS_INTEGER := 0;
  lv_perf_label   VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Runner Delivery KPI Report (Top ' || co_report_limit || ')');
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Runner Filter: ' || CASE WHEN p_runner_id IS NULL THEN 'ALL' ELSE TO_CHAR(p_runner_id) END);
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('----------------------------------------');

  -- Rank runners by completed orders; cancellations (non-null/non-empty) are excluded.
  FOR rec IN (
    WITH cleaned AS (
      SELECT
        pro.runner_id,
        CASE
          WHEN pro.distance IS NULL OR TRIM(pro.distance) IS NULL THEN 0
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(pro.distance), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')
            THEN TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(pro.distance), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?'))
          ELSE 0
        END AS distance_km,
        CASE
          WHEN pro.duration IS NULL OR TRIM(pro.duration) IS NULL THEN 0
          WHEN REGEXP_LIKE(TRIM(pro.duration), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?')
            THEN TO_NUMBER(REGEXP_SUBSTR(TRIM(pro.duration), '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?'))
          ELSE 0
        END AS duration_min
      FROM MODERN_DATA.PIZZA_RUNNER_ORDERS pro
      WHERE (pro.cancellation IS NULL OR TRIM(pro.cancellation) IS NULL)
        AND (p_runner_id IS NULL OR pro.runner_id = p_runner_id)
    ), agg AS (
      SELECT
        c.runner_id,
        COUNT(*) AS completed_orders,
        SUM(c.distance_km) AS total_km,
        SUM(c.duration_min) AS total_minutes,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(c.distance_km) / COUNT(*), 2) END AS avg_km_per_order,
        CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(c.duration_min) / COUNT(*), 2) END AS avg_minutes_per_order
      FROM cleaned c
      GROUP BY c.runner_id
    ), ranked AS (
      SELECT
        a.runner_id,
        a.completed_orders,
        a.total_km,
        a.total_minutes,
        a.avg_km_per_order,
        a.avg_minutes_per_order,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY a.completed_orders DESC, a.total_km DESC, a.runner_id) AS rn
      FROM agg a
    )
    SELECT
      r.runner_id,
      r.completed_orders,
      r.total_km,
      r.total_minutes,
      r.avg_km_per_order,
      r.avg_minutes_per_order
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn <= co_report_limit
    ORDER BY r.rn
  ) LOOP
    lv_rows_printed := lv_rows_printed + 1;

    -- Control-flow classification based on avg minutes per order.
    IF rec.avg_minutes_per_order <= 20 THEN
      lv_perf_label := 'HIGH';
    ELSIF rec.avg_minutes_per_order <= 35 THEN
      lv_perf_label := 'MEDIUM';
    ELSE
      lv_perf_label := 'LOW';
    END IF;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('runner_id=' || rec.runner_id ||
                         ' completed_orders=' || rec.completed_orders ||
                         ' total_km=' || TO_CHAR(rec.total_km) ||
                         ' total_minutes=' || TO_CHAR(rec.total_minutes) ||
                         ' avg_km_per_order=' || TO_CHAR(rec.avg_km_per_order) ||
                         ' avg_minutes_per_order=' || TO_CHAR(rec.avg_minutes_per_order) ||
                         ' performance=' || lv_perf_label);
  END LOOP;

  IF lv_rows_printed = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No deliveries matched the criteria.');
    -- Ensure a deterministic, testable NO_DATA_FOUND path.
    RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
  END IF;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No deliveries matched the criteria.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_runner_delivery_kpis;
/

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE pr_season_batting_snapshot(
  p_season_id IN IPL.MATCH.season_id%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_ball_rows NUMBER;
BEGIN
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Season: ' || p_season_id);

  -- Guard: ensure the season has ball-level batting data to report.
  SELECT COUNT(*)
    INTO lv_ball_rows
    FROM IPL.MATCH m
    INNER JOIN IPL.BATSMAN_SCORED bs
      ON bs.match_id = m.match_id
   WHERE m.season_id = p_season_id;

  IF lv_ball_rows = 0 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('Player', 35) || ' ' || LPAD('Matches', 7) || ' ' || LPAD('Runs', 7) || ' ' || LPAD('Balls', 7) || ' ' || LPAD('SR', 8) || ' ' || LPAD('Outs', 6));
  DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(RPAD('-', 35, '-') || ' ' || LPAD('-', 7, '-') || ' ' || LPAD('-', 7, '-') || ' ' || LPAD('-', 7, '-') || ' ' || LPAD('-', 8, '-') || ' ' || LPAD('-', 6, '-'));

  -- Rank players by runs within the season; compute strike rate defensively.
  FOR rec IN (
    WITH
      batting AS (
        SELECT
          bbb.striker AS player_id,
          COUNT(DISTINCT bbb.match_id) AS matches_played,
          SUM(bs.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
          COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
        FROM IPL.MATCH m
        INNER JOIN IPL.BALL_BY_BALL bbb
          ON bbb.match_id = m.match_id
        INNER JOIN IPL.BATSMAN_SCORED bs
          ON bs.match_id = bbb.match_id
         AND bs.over_id = bbb.over_id
         AND bs.ball_id = bbb.ball_id
         AND bs.innings_no = bbb.innings_no
        WHERE m.season_id = p_season_id
        GROUP BY bbb.striker
      ),
      outs AS (
        SELECT
          wt.player_out AS player_id,
          COUNT(*) AS outs
        FROM IPL.MATCH m
        INNER JOIN IPL.WICKET_TAKEN wt
          ON wt.match_id = m.match_id
        WHERE m.season_id = p_season_id
        GROUP BY wt.player_out
      ),
      ranked AS (
        SELECT
          p.player_name,
          b.matches_played,
          b.total_runs,
          b.balls_faced,
          CASE
            WHEN b.balls_faced = 0 THEN 0
            ELSE (b.total_runs * 100) / b.balls_faced
          END AS strike_rate,
          NVL(o.outs, 0) AS outs,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY b.total_runs DESC, b.balls_faced ASC, p.player_name ASC) AS rn
        FROM batting b
        INNER JOIN IPL.PLAYER p
          ON p.player_id = b.player_id
        LEFT OUTER JOIN outs o
          ON o.player_id = b.player_id
      )
    SELECT
      r.player_name,
      r.matches_played,
      r.total_runs,
      r.balls_faced,
      r.strike_rate,
      r.outs
    FROM ranked r
    WHERE r.rn <= co_report_limit
    ORDER BY r.rn
  ) LOOP
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      RPAD(rec.player_name, 35) || ' ' ||
      LPAD(rec.matches_played, 7) || ' ' ||
      LPAD(rec.total_runs, 7) || ' ' ||
      LPAD(rec.balls_faced, 7) || ' ' ||
      LPAD(TO_CHAR(ROUND(rec.strike_rate, 2), '990D00'), 8) || ' ' ||
      LPAD(rec.outs, 6)
    );
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found.');
  WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Multiple rows returned.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END pr_season_batting_snapshot;
/

question:
The operations team wants a reusable routine to monitor delivery performance for a specific hub and month.

Build a stored procedure that:
 Accepts a hub city and a year/month.
 Pulls up to 15 “store-channel” performance lines for that hub city and month, using the business rule: only consider orders that have a matching delivery (via delivery_order_id).
 For each store and channel, show the number of orders, the total order amount, and the average delivery distance in meters.
 Categorize each line into a performance tier (SHORT/MEDIUM/LONG) based on average distance (< 2000, < 5000, otherwise).
 Print the lines to DBMS_OUTPUT in a readable format.
 Handle bad inputs (like an invalid month) and any runtime problems gracefully with exception handling; the procedure should never raise an error to the caller.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: report_hub_monthly_delivery_perf
Parameters:
p_hub_city IN DELIVERY_CENTER.HUBS.hub_city%TYPE
p_year IN DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS.order_created_year%TYPE
p_month IN DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS.order_created_month%TYPE
Output:
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Input validation failed: month must be between 1 and 12.')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No matching data for the given hub city and month.')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('STORE=' || rec.store_name || ' | CHANNEL=' || rec.channel_name || ' | ORDERS=' || rec.order_cnt || ' | TOTAL_AMT=' || rec.total_amount || ' | AVG_DISTANCE_M=' || rec.avg_distance_meters || ' | TIER=' || lv_tier)
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No matching data for the given hub city and month.'
WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN: 'Input validation failed: month must be between 1 and 12.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
reference_answer:
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE report_hub_monthly_delivery_perf(
  p_hub_city IN DELIVERY_CENTER.HUBS.hub_city%TYPE,
  p_year     IN DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS.order_created_year%TYPE,
  p_month    IN DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS.order_created_month%TYPE
) IS
  co_report_limit CONSTANT PLS_INTEGER := 15; -- Limit output for report readability

  lv_tier VARCHAR2(10);
BEGIN
  -- Basic input validation (month range)
  IF p_month IS NULL OR p_month < 1 OR p_month > 12 THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Input validation failed: month must be between 1 and 12.');
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  -- If the query returns no rows, the FOR loop won't execute; guard with NO_DATA_FOUND via a pre-check.
  DECLARE
    lv_exists NUMBER;
  BEGIN
    SELECT 1
      INTO lv_exists
      FROM DELIVERY_CENTER.HUBS h
      INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.STORES s
        ON s.hub_id = h.hub_id
      INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS o
        ON o.store_id = s.store_id
      INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.DELIVERIES d
        ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
     WHERE h.hub_city = p_hub_city
       AND o.order_created_year = p_year
       AND o.order_created_month = p_month
       AND ROWNUM = 1;
  END;

  FOR rec IN (
    SELECT *
      FROM (
        SELECT s.store_name AS store_name,
               c.channel_name AS channel_name,
               COUNT(*) AS order_cnt,
               SUM(o.order_amount) AS total_amount,
               ROUND(AVG(d.delivery_distance_meters)) AS avg_distance_meters
          FROM DELIVERY_CENTER.HUBS h
          INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.STORES s
            ON s.hub_id = h.hub_id
          INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.ORDERS o
            ON o.store_id = s.store_id
          INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.CHANNELS c
            ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id
          INNER JOIN DELIVERY_CENTER.DELIVERIES d
            ON d.delivery_order_id = o.delivery_order_id
         WHERE h.hub_city = p_hub_city
           AND o.order_created_year = p_year
           AND o.order_created_month = p_month
         GROUP BY s.store_name, c.channel_name
         ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, s.store_name, c.channel_name
      )
     WHERE ROWNUM <= co_report_limit
  ) LOOP
    -- Tiering based on average distance
    IF rec.avg_distance_meters < 2000 THEN
      lv_tier := 'SHORT';
    ELSIF rec.avg_distance_meters < 5000 THEN
      lv_tier := 'MEDIUM';
    ELSE
      lv_tier := 'LONG';
    END IF;

    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE(
      'STORE=' || rec.store_name ||
      ' | CHANNEL=' || rec.channel_name ||
      ' | ORDERS=' || rec.order_cnt ||
      ' | TOTAL_AMT=' || rec.total_amount ||
      ' | AVG_DISTANCE_M=' || rec.avg_distance_meters ||
      ' | TIER=' || lv_tier
    );
  END LOOP;

EXCEPTION
  WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No matching data for the given hub city and month.');
  WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Input validation failed: month must be between 1 and 12.');
  WHEN OTHERS THEN
    DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Unexpected error.');
END report_hub_monthly_delivery_perf;
/

question:
Build a reusable stored procedure that prints a small CPI-U trend report for a given area and item.

The procedure should:
Validate inputs (area name and item name) and reject empty strings.
Pull up to 15 rows of CPI-U values for the requested area/item across a year range.
Convert VALUE from text to number safely and compute a year-over-year (YoY) percent change by comparing the same PERIOD to the prior year.
Print each row with the date, value, and YoY percent change (or N/A when not available).
If no rows exist for the filter, print a clear message instead of failing.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: pr_cpi_u_trend_report
Parameters:
p_area_name IN BLS.CPI_U.area_name%TYPE
p_item_name IN BLS.CPI_U.item_name%TYPE
p_year_start IN BLS.CPI_U.year%TYPE
p_year_end IN BLS.CPI_U.year%TYPE
Output:
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('CPI-U Trend Report (up to ' || co_report_limit || ' rows)')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Area=' || p_area_name || '; Item=' || p_item_name || '; Years=' || p_year_start || '-' || p_year_end)
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Date=' || TO_CHAR(rec.c_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '; Value=' || TO_CHAR(rec.value_num) || '; YoY%=' || TO_CHAR(ROUND(rec.yoy_pct, 2)))
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Date=' || TO_CHAR(rec.c_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') || '; Value=' || TO_CHAR(rec.value_num) || '; YoY%=N/A')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No data found for the given filters.')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input: area name is required.')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input: item name is required.')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input: year range is required.')
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Invalid input: year_start must be <= year_end.')
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found for the given filters.'
WHEN VALUE_ERROR THEN: 'Invalid numeric CPI value encountered.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'

You are reviewing stacking model experiments and need a compact audit-style report.

Write an anonymous PL/SQL block that, for a given solution name (p_solution_name) and version (p_version), prints a row-limited report (max 15 rows) listing the top base models (from MODEL_IMPORTANCE) for that solution (ordered by importance descending). For each base model, also show its train/test score (from MODEL_SCORE) for the same name/version/step.

Processing rules:
 Use an explicit cursor (OPEN/FETCH/CLOSE) to iterate the ranked models.
 Only include rows for the exact solution name/version.
 Join model importance to model score by (name, version, step, model).
 For each fetched row, categorize the model as:
   'GOOD' if test_score >= 0.80
   'OK' if test_score between 0.60 and 0.79
   'POOR' otherwise
 Print each line as: Step=, Model=, Importance=, Train=, Test=, Category=
 Track how many rows were printed, and at the end print a summary: 'Rows printed: '
 Handle the case where the cursor returns zero rows with a clear message.
 Include robust exception handling so no runtime errors propagate.

Requirements:
Procedure Name: Anonymous Block
Parameters:
None
Output:
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Top base models for solution=' || p_solution_name || ', version=' || p_version);
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Step=' || lv_step || ', Model=' || lv_model || ', Importance=' || TO_CHAR(lv_importance) || ', Train=' || TO_CHAR(lv_train_score) || ', Test=' || TO_CHAR(lv_test_score) || ', Category=' || lv_category);
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('No model importance rows found for the given solution name/version.');
DBMS_OUTPUT.PUT_LINE('Rows printed: ' || TO_CHAR(lv_rows_printed));
Exception Handling:
WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN: 'No data found.'
WHEN TOO_MANY_ROWS THEN: 'Multiple rows returned.'
WHEN OTHERS THEN: 'Unexpected error.'
